definitions.explanation: In a thin, modest way that barely continues — used of a livelihood, business, or activity that just manages to keep going.

examples.japanese: {細々|ほそぼそ}と⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{細々|ほそぼそ}と⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: We keep the shop going, just barely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{細々|ほそぼそ}と⟦{生活|せいかつ}している→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: They scrape by on their pension alone.

notes:
Describes something continuing only on a small, barely-sustained scale. Often paired with ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧, ⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧, or ⟦{生活|せいかつ}する→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧.

Note the reading: as an adverb of 'barely' it is ほそぼそ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧; the same characters read こまごま⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ mean 'in fine detail.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細々|ほそぼそ}と⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live a modest, hand-to-mouth life
- {細々|ほそぼそ}と⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to keep something going on a small scale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- かろうじて: barely; only just — emphasizes a narrow margin, not an ongoing modest scale
- つつましく: modestly; frugally — a positive nuance of restraint
